info.name: Referral Portal API
info.description:
Walks the referral workflow: jobs (draft, publish, close), referrals, duplicate protection, the one-step-at-a-time pipeline, the dashboard and security.
Start the backend first (http://localhost:8109). Repeatable: it registers a fresh employee and uses unique job titles and candidate emails.

item.name: Register a fresh employee for this run
2. Recruiter creates and publishes a job
Create a job (starts as a draft)

exec: pm.test("Draft, duplicate skills removed", () => { pm.expect(j.status).to.eql("DRAFT"); pm.expect(j.skills).to.eql(["Postman", "Testing"]); });

item.name: A draft is invisible to employees

exec: pm.test("Says it is not open", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("not open"));

item.name: Employees now find it by text

exec: pm.test("Found by skill, ignoring case", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().some(j => j.id == pm.collectionVariables.get("jobId"))).to.be.true);
pm.test("Submitted, may move to screening or be rejected", () => { pm.expect(r.status).to.eql("SUBMITTED"); pm.expect(r.allowedNext).to.eql(["SCREENING", "REJECTED"]); });

item.name: Same candidate again is a conflict
Another employee cannot refer the same candidate (email case ignored)
Bad email, phone and resume link are rejected
Another employee does not see them
5. Recruiter moves referrals through the pipeline

exec: pm.test("Both are there, with referrer details", () => { const l = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(l.length).to.eql(2); pm.expect(l[0].referrerUsername).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("newUser")); });

item.name: Skipping a stage is a conflict

exec: pm.test("Says what is allowed", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include("screening or rejected"));

item.name: Move to screening with a note

exec: pm.test("Screening, recorded", () => { const r = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(r.status).to.eql("SCREENING"); pm.expect(r.updatedBy).to.eql("recruiter"); pm.expect(r.statusNote).to.eql("Phone screen booked"); });

item.name: Employee sees the progress and the note

exec: pm.test("Visible to the referrer", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json()[0].statusNote).to.eql("Phone screen booked"));
pm.test("Selected, nothing further allowed", () => { const r = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(r.status).to.eql("SELECTED"); pm.expect(r.allowedNext).to.eql([]); });

item.name: 6. Closing a job and the dashboard
A closed job takes no new referrals
Employees no longer see the job
Recruiter still sees it with its referral count

exec: pm.test("Two referrals", () => { const j = pm.response.json().find(x => x.id == pm.collectionVariables.get("jobId")); pm.expect(j.referralCount).to.eql(2); });

item.name: Recruiter has no personal referral list
